text:
Anya: dropping a new compact iteration: token 'peek' pill, single stop FAB, regen in overflow. want quick takes on behavior + copy.
Matt: nice. q: should token peek be live-updating while streaming or snapshot at completion?
Anya: live, but subtle. no attention-grabbing motion.
Sophia: accessibility concern: continuous live updates will spam screen readers. only announce final totals via aria-live.
DesignBot: accessibility recs: role=status for final token summary, aria-atomic=true for final posts, and provide keyboard-focusable breakdown.
Jess: idea: show a tiny "regen estimate" hint next to Regenerate: "~+24". toggle-able in prompt library.
Matt: agree on optional estimate. default off for first-time users.
Ryan: stop vs pause: product wants minimal chrome. primary Stop icon (kills generation, preserves partial). Regenerate in overflow clears and re-runs.
Anya: UX note: show a transient toast when Regenerate triggers with the estimated cost and link to view breakdown.
Sophia: for high-cost regens (>600 tokens) require a confirm modal. otherwise toast is fine.
Jess: microcopy drafts: Stop tooltip: "Stop generation — keep partial reply." Regenerate tooltip: "Regenerate reply" Toast: "Regenerating (~+45 tokens)"
Matt: microcopy tweak: prefer imperative single words on buttons: "Stop", "Regenerate". tooltips can be slightly longer but concise.
Anya: token peek placement options: bubble-corner pill vs composer-inline badge. corner is less noisy. show current/limit like "98/2048". hover reveals input/output split.
DesignBot: hover must be keyboard-accessible. provide a small "details" button with aria-expanded that opens breakdown.
Ryan: prompt library pinning: pinned prompt updates token peek in realtime. pinned-preview inline-edit opens full editor.
Jess: question: should regen estimate include potential pinned-prompt edits? we should calculate both with the current pinned state and the saved library version. include pinned_prompt_id in telemetry.
Matt: engineering: batch token UI updates every 200-300ms (250ms recommended). don't update at frame rate.
DesignBot: spec: update_interval=250ms, aria-live final-only, breakdown panel reachable by keyboard, color contrast >=4.5:1 and not color-only.
Anya: decision checkpoint: <=600 token delta -> non-blocking toast; >600 -> confirm modal with quick-confirm checkbox. capture event: regen_requested {estimate_before, estimate_after, pinned_prompt_id}.
Ryan: I'll add those telemetry fields to the spec doc.
Jess: I'll write final copy variants and small toast/modal copy options by EOD.
Matt: I'll prototype the debounce + aria hooks in the playground branch and post a gif.
Anya: thanks all wave — attaching mock: https://img.redwood.mock/ux/tokenpeek-2001112222.png
Sophia: tiny a11y nit: token pill focus outline must be visible at 3px and not rely on color.
DesignBot: noted. closing checklist: pill variants, overflow menu order, toast vs modal thresholds, telemetry names + fields.
Anya: perfect — please ping when PRs land.
